# Copilot Instructions for WebLED

**AGENTS FILES ARE CRUCIAL AND REQUIRED CONTEXT FOR EVERY TASK.**

Before implementation, always discover and read all agents instructions.

Run this from repository root to find all occurrences:

find . -type f \( -name 'AGENTS.md' -o -name 'agents.md' \)

This command finds every agents file so the agent can load them and use them as operating guidance.

Apply found files.

Do not proceed until this context is loaded.
